Each episode includes: • Easy English explanations • Useful vocabulary and phrases • Real-life news topics • Listening practice for everyday conversations
New episodes are published twice a week to help you improve your English step by step. Whether you're just starting or want to speak English more confidently, I-FAL makes learning simple, practical, and effective.
